research.title: Robust Intent Classification Under Paraphrase Variation
bullets: Designed supervised experiments with supervisor guidance to compare intent classifiers under paraphrase variation, controlling training splits and label distributions.
Evaluated lexical and transformer baselines using macro F score and calibration metrics, examining errors associated with lexical overlap and ambiguous requests.

publications.title: Evaluating Intent Classifier Robustness and Calibration Under Paraphrase Variation

work.title: Text Processing Components for Support Ticket Routing
bullets: Implemented Python components for ticket text normalization and routing rule execution, following existing interface specifications and handling malformed input records.
Added unit tests for preprocessing edge cases and investigated routing defects through log inspection and reproducible test fixtures.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Document Retrieval Baselines
bullets: Implemented TF-IDF and Okapi best matching retrieval baselines for a document collection, using shared tokenization and relevance judgments for comparison.
Compared ranking quality with mean reciprocal rank and inspected failed queries involving vocabulary mismatch, rare terms, and document length.

projects.title: Sequence Tagging for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented recurrent and transformer token classifiers for named entity recognition, aligning subword labels and applying consistent training and evaluation splits.
Compared entity-level precision and recall across architectures, reviewing boundary errors and confusions between organization, location, and person mentions.
